pageCache.pageTitle: Welcome | College Green Nursery School & Services
pageCache.text:
College Green Nursery School & Services
Welcome
I would like to personally welcome you to our fantastic school community and look forward to sharing your child's learning journey with us. Our core belief at College Green School & Services is that all our children should feel safe, happy, valued, celebrated, challenged and have fun whilst learning at the school.
I am a dedicated headteacher who loves her job, and is passionate about the early years!
My staff team and I are very excited about the prospect of taking College Green School & Services into a school of the future by creating next generation learning and embarking on a new phase in College Green School & Services' journey and existence.
We look forward to working in partnership with you and your child and I am sure together we can create one of the most memorable periods in your child's life and College Green's history!

pageCache.pageTitle: Mission Statement | College Green Nursery School & Services
pageCache.text:
College Green Nursery School & Services
Is to equip every child with a strong sense of belonging and a life-long love for learning. To empower them to be compassionate and resilient whilst celebrating their remarkable individuality.
Adventurous, Courageous, and Extraordinary are intrinsically woven into the fabric of College Green - they sit within our practice, our environment, our whole staff team and our children.
We are proud of our exemplary curriculum and celebrate every child’s growth, development and happiness
OUR MISSION Is to provide a joyful, adventurous and ambitious curriculum that actively inspires curiosity, exploration and resilience. To make a tangible difference to every individual's childhood and beyond.
TO OFFER an unforgettable nursery provision and aspirational early year's education, through continuous reflection, innovation and evidence base inclusive practice. To collaborate with parents, carers, governors and the wider community to create enriching positive learning experiences.
TO EVOKE a sense of self and belonging early in life ant to nurture our children to feel safe, valued and be individually remarkable. To encourage emotional regulation and empathy within every child and promote the desire to act compassionately and continue to build positive relationships throughout life - and above all stimulate/establish a lasting love for learning

Are you interested in becoming a school governor?
Brent is actively looking for people to be school governors. You don't have to be an expert in education or a parent; almost anyone can help.
Being a school governor brings with it a real responsibility and a sense that you are able to contribute to the good of schools and pupils. It's a worthwhile task, but before offering to help it would be good to consider what it entails by reading our governors information.
If, after you have read about what is involved, you are still interested in becoming a school governor then you can download the governor application form at governor.services@brent.gov.uk

SEND & Inclusion Statement for College Green School & Services
“Provision for children with SEND is exemplary. Staff are skilled at identifying children’s specific needs and interests early. They work with parents to put the necessary adaptations in place. This enables children to enjoy the same curriculum as their peers and join in with all aspects of school life. External expertise is used well to provide precise support when needed”
At College Green School & Services, we are committed to providing an inclusive and nurturing environment where every child is valued, respected, and supported to reach their full potential.
We believe that all children, regardless of their abilities or additional needs, have the right to a high-quality education that promotes their development, well-being, and sense of belonging.
Our Commitment to SEND and Inclusion:
Please click on the link below to read our current SEND information which outlines the support that is in place at College Green School & Services.
Special Educational Needs Coordinator (SENDCO) - Nawal Filali
Contact sendco@cgss.brent.sch.uk
Here you can find information on how College Green School & Services supports children with special educational needs and disabilities (SEND). Please click on the links below to read our current SEND information which outlines the support that College Green School & Services already has in place.
SEND information Report 2024-2025
Send & Inclusion Policy - Draft
Accessibility Plan - 2024-2025
The Local Offer
Local Authorities and schools are required to publish and keep under review information about services they expect to be available for the children and young people with Special Educational Needs and/or disabilities (SEND) aged 0-25. This is known as the ‘Local Offer’.
The intention of the Local Offer is to improve choice and transparency for families. It will also be an important resource for parents in understanding the range of services and provision in the local area. Information is published as part of the SEND reforms under the Children and Families Act 2014.
Brent Council's Local Offer can be found here:
www.brent.gov.uk/localoffer

What is Safeguarding?
Safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children is defined for the purposes of this guidance as:
Children includes everyone under the age of 18.
College Green School and Services has a controlled entry system, we ask that Parents and Visitors to the school buildings work with us to ensure the safety of our children. Visitors must always sign in at the main school office before entering the school building and wear their visitors badge at all times. Parents who are dropping or collecting children at times outside of normal drop off/collection times must go to the school office. College Green Nursery School & Services
Friends of College Green has been going strong since 2017. This committee is made up of a group of volunteers; parents, relatives, friends or people from the community who lead the organisation of events and activities to raise funds for our school or charities.
If you are interested in joining our Friends of College Green group please contact us at FOCG@cgss.brent.sch.uk
Its 2021 and due to circumstances we have not been able to hold our normal school fundraising events that everyone has so enjoyed in previous years. However, our superhero parents, pupils and governors have instead taken it apon themselves to organise some amazing suprise fundraising! Thank you College Green Community, we are really feeling the love and support.
Firstly earlier in the year Paul Foley arranged a sponsered haircut and raised a massive £4720 for the school, this has been gratefully recieved and will go towards the fund for our 'Barefoot Garden! Thank you Paul
Secondly - When parents heard that College Green couldn't hold its usual summer fair because of the world pandemic, they decided to try and raise funds with bake sells and challenges at home in their garden, one child set himself a series of challenges including climbing a giant sand dune in under ten seconds, running down sideways like a crab, jumping one metre long,doing ten pressups,catching a crab, doing a backflip and wheelbarrowing to the finish line. This is his film -
The parents of CGSS 2020 -2021 raised a grand total of £ 1,129 this is remarkable we are most grateful and use this for the benefit of future children.

pageCache.pageTitle: Forms | College Green Nursery School & Services
pageCache.text:
College Green Nursery School & Services
Absences are strongly discouraged during term time, however if an absence is unavoidable please complete and return the appropriate request for leave form.
Please click here for full details of our Attendance policy.
We ask that Parents (where ever possible) arrange for medical appointments and holidays to be taken outside of normal school hours. However if you are unable to avoid taking leave during school time please complete and return a request for leave. Please make sure the request for leave is submitted at least two weeks prior to the planned absence. Your request will be reviewed using our absence policy and you will be contacted in writing to confirm if the leave would fall into the authorised or unauthorised absence reporting category.
Medical - Request for Leave.pdf
Holiday - request for leave.pdf
If your child has or develops a medical need we will support their attendance at Nursery in the best way possible for your child. For a long term medical need it is important that staff are aware of the diagnosis, signs and symptoms to look out for and if any medication or emergency care is needed. Similarly if your child develops a short term illness that requires medication to be administered by the Nursery setting, we will require you to complete a short term medical form.
ALL medication must be prescribed by an authorised pharmacy with the prescription label showing the childs name, dosage and frequency.
Short Term - provides us with authorisation to administer prescribed medication for a short period e.g. antibiotics for an infection.
Individual Healthcare Plan - short term consent.pdf
Long Term - provides us with authorisation to administer medication required for a long term condition or in a potential emergency. e.g, asthma pump, epi-pen, insulin etc.
Individual Healthcare Plan - Long term consent.pdf
We work with our caterers to ensure that any confirmed food allergies are accounted for in our lunch and tea menu's in order to do amend our menu's and to make sure that we are fully prepared for any potential reactions we need to have all of the information relating to your childs allergy. This includes a copy of your Allergy Information sheet supplied by your GP or health care professional along with the two forms on the right.
If your child requires an epipen or antihistamine to be kept on site you will also need to complete and return the Long Term Health Care Plan.
Caterlink Allergy and intolerance form.pdf

College Green Nursery School & Services
COLLEGE GREEN SCHOOL & SERVICES ADMISSIONS
please read all the information very carefully to ensure that you have the correct information for your child's age group
We have two provisions: a Neighbourhood Nursery (2 - 3 years old) and a pre-school (3 - 4 years old) that operate on the same campus. Both share a love of learning and education, with children's development, joy and wellbeing at the heart of our services. Our aim is to provide remarkable, unforgettable and excellent early years education and to Inspire children, staff, the school and wider community to respect and embrace difference.

Preschool Nursery - CLICK HERE IF YOUR CHILD TURNS 3 YEARS OLD BETWEEN 1st SEPTEMBER 2026 AND 31st AUGUST 2027
In accordance with the Nursery contract, fees may increase annually by inflation (RPI) plus 2%. Following a review of costs, the nursery and governors have determined that the fee increase for the September 2026 intake will be 4.6% which is below this contractual maximum.
